facial_rig.reason: The cinematic presenter must visibly move its mouth while narrating. The optimized head is a single closed skin (lips are a textured seam on a continuous surface, no mouth cavity, no teeth/tongue geometry), so an anatomically open mouth would tear the surface or expose a hole. The honest motion this topology supports is a restrained JAW DROP.
facial_rig.control: one glTF morph target named `jawOpen` on the single mesh (a lower-lip/chin/jaw-underside rotation about a jaw hinge; nose, upper lip, cheeks, eyes, forehead and hair are untouched)
facial_rig.step_script: assets/pipeline/add_presenter_face_rig.py (input system-presenter-anim.glb -> output published GLB; preserves skeleton, skin weights, materials, textures and the idle/talk/talk2 clips)
facial_rig.region_selection: authored against the INSPECTED mesh, not guessed percentages. Landmarks (world metres, from .affordwork/inspect-presenter-profile.py on the shipped mesh): nose tip z=1.529 (MUST NOT MOVE), upper lip z~1.515 (zero influence), lips z~1.50-1.51, lower lip z~1.495, chin front z~1.472-1.490, chin underside z~1.451-1.462, neck z<1.44 (zero). Masked by height + front depth + lateral centre so hair at the sides never moves.
facial_rig.open_angle_at_full: 0.20 rad (~11.5 deg) at morph influence 1.0; runtime caps the driven influence at JAW_OPEN_MAX=0.6 and text-driven peaks land ~0.36 (subtle, believable).
facial_rig.verifier: assets/pipeline/verify_presenter_face.py (asserts jawOpen exists and only moves the lower-front face, idle/talk/talk2 survive, 24 joints + skin intact, 1 material + texture present, height in the human band with feet on the ground, jaw does not change the silhouette). PASS.
facial_rig.browser_qa: Real Chrome at 1024x692 and 1440x900 via .affordwork/qa-presenter-mouth.mjs and a live morph-influence probe (.affordwork/qa-presenter-morph-probe.mjs): speaking drives a varying, capped jaw influence (min 0.00, max ~0.36, ~19 distinct levels) that closes to 0 in silence; face readable, holographic (no cyan blowout), stable viewer-facing head/eye line, no console/page errors.
facial_rig.runtime: apps/web/src/module/SystemPresenter.tsx discovers the jawOpen morph and drives it every frame from the deterministic apps/web/src/module/moduleLipSync.ts sampler (speechJawInfluence), with per-frame smoothing; silence/pause/reduced-motion close the mouth. Provider seam preserved for future ElevenLabs alignment.
facial_rig.honest_scope: This is broad jaw/mouth motion, NOT phoneme-perfect viseme sync. The user only requires believable mouth motion.

appearance_refinement.reason: The first published head shipped at a uniform 30k decimation that shattered the curved face/hair into a sparse shell soup (angular nose facets, a mirror-seam ridge down the midline, and jagged hair/decolletage shards). The base 51k Meshy reconstruction does NOT have these; they were purely a decimation artifact, so the fix is to preserve the camera-facing geometry rather than to smooth the broken result (which only spread the shards).
appearance_refinement.diagnosis: Inspected the shipped mesh: 2641 disconnected components (largest 140 verts, 1952 tiny fragments) held together only by baked custom split normals. Any vertex smoothing collapses the thin shells and any normal recompute shades the fragments as shards. The pre-decimation rigged base (51,324 tris) renders as a smooth, symmetric, camera-ready face under the same neutral light.
appearance_refinement.approach: Re-ran the SAME pipeline from the rigged base with the camera-facing upper body protected from the decimator, so the head/hair/torso keep base density while the lower body still decimates to hold a reasonable budget. No hand-editing of the public GLB, no procedural primitives, no texture repaint.
appearance_refinement.optimize_change: optimize_system_presenter.py extended with an optional protectFrac argument: verts whose world height is above (minZ + protectFrac*height) get zero decimate-collapse weight. Published build used targetTris=46000, maxTex=1024, protectFrac=0.60 (top 40% protected). Base texture was 2048 (clamped to 1024, unchanged from the 30k build).
pipeline_rerun: optimize_system_presenter.py rigged-base -> system-presenter-rigged-opt-hi.glb (46,008 tris, protected 34,020 verts / decimated 7,593)
fix_rig_emissive.py -> system-presenter-rigged-opt-hi-fixed.glb (same body-albedo-as-emissive clear; BIN unchanged)
bake_character_anims.py idle,talk,talk2 -> system-presenter-anim-hi.glb (same Mixamo sources + retarget)
add_presenter_face_rig.py -> system-presenter-face-hi.glb (jawOpen morph re-derived from the inspected mesh; moved 1412 verts, max drop 0.0200 m)

appearance_refinement.boundary_compliance: Adult, conventionally attractive, school-appropriate. Appeal comes from cleaner facial geometry, symmetry, defined eyes/lips, tidy hair and confident posture. No anatomical enlargement, no cleavage, no revealing clothing; the professional blazer/open-collar blouse/trousers and full coverage are preserved from the reference.

Eyes/lips/skin detail live in the baked albedo and were not repainted. Not an exact identity likeness.
